 Nagpur Bench : Nagpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard.

2. This is an application seeking to quash First Information Report in Crime No.574/2023 with
Police Station Buldhana City, District Buldhana for the offence punishable under Sections 354,
354B, 509, 498A read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860..
3. The applicants are husband and other relatives of the informant lady.

She alleges that on
28.06.2023 the applicant No.1 (father-in-law) cursed her for not having a male child and then
outraged her modesty, therefore, the offence.
4. It is the applicant's contention that divorce proceedings is going on.
5.  In response to the summons, informant has appeared in said proceedings on 30.06.2023.
She has filed report on 02.07.2023 stating the old incident dated 28.06.2023.
It is submitted that since November, 2022 the informant is residing separately due to matrimonial differences.
Issue notice to the non-applicants, returnable on 29.04.2024.
